blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Effective robotic manipulation calls for multimodal memory and rapid adaptation to shifts in contact dynamics. However, many existing policies, which retain either visual or wrench history, may miss key cues from the other modality. Moreover, even with wrench memory, fixed policies can struggle when contact conditions shift at deployment. To this end, we introduce M$^{2}$AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action model that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, the model uses test-time training (TTT) to encode observation history in fast weights. Each entry in the bounded TTT bank combines the corresponding frame's features with a readout from these weights, preserving cues that predate the oldest retained frame. For wrench memory, a context gate controls how much the action expert draws on wrench history as it jointly denoises future actions and wrenches. For predictive test-time adaptation, the auxiliary wrench prediction loss also provides online self-supervision. Using measured wrenches as targets, we update low-rank policy adapters by backpropagating only through the final denoising step. Real-world experiments show that the TTT bank outperforms visual memory baselines on progress tracking, scene recall, and demonstration following. On contact-sensitive tasks, the context gate yields higher success rates than direct injection or gated cross-attention. Predictive test-time adaptation improves robustness to shifts in contact dynamics. On eight tasks requiring visual and wrench memory, M$^{2}$AdaptVLA achieves a mean success rate of 82.71%, a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline. The project page is available at https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/.
blocks.zh: 有效的机器人操纵需要多模式记忆和快速适应接触动态的变化. 然而,许多现行政策要么保留视觉历史,要么保留扳手历史,可能错过了另一种模式的关键提示。 此外,即使有了扳手记忆,当部署时接触条件发生变化时,固定政策也会挣扎. 为此,我们引入了M$^{2}$AdaptVLA,一种视觉-语言-动作模型,将视觉和扳手记忆与预测的测试-时间适应相结合. 对于视觉内存,模型使用测试时间训练(TTT)来将观测历史编码为快重. 被捆绑的TTT银行的每个条目将相应帧的特性与这些重量的读出结合起来,保留了最古老的保留帧之前的提示. 对于扳手记忆,一个上下文门控制着动作专家在联合去除未来动作和扳手时所汲取的扳手历史的多少. 对于预测测试时间的适应,辅助扳手预测损失也提供在线自导自演. 利用测量到的扳手作为目标,我们更新低级的政策适配器,只通过最后去名步骤进行回向宣传. 真实世界的实验表明,TTT银行在进度跟踪,场景回想,以及随后的演示方面,能比视觉内存基线表现得更好. 在接触敏感的任务中,上下文门的成功率高于直接注射或门式交叉注意。 预测性的试验时间适应性可提高接触动态的稳健性。 在需要视觉和扳手记忆的8项任务上,M$^{2}$AdaptVLA实现了82.71%的中度成功率,比最强基线的绝对增益31.46%. 项目网页见https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent work has incorporated memory into vision-language-action (VLA) models and demonstrated its effectiveness on robotic manipulation tasks in which the next action depends on sensory information gathered over time [ 26 , 31 , 18 , 32 , 36 ] . Many memory-augmented policies focus on a single sensory history, using either visual memory to retain earlier observations [ 46 , 13 , 23 , 8 ] or wrench memory to retain the forces and torques measured during contact [ 17 , 11 , 19 ] . However, a policy that relies on a single memory modality may miss key cues from the other modality, making it difficult to perform tasks that require both.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将记忆纳入视觉语言-动作(VLA)模型,并显示出其对机器人操纵任务的有效性,其中下一个动作依赖于随着时间的推移收集的感官信息[26,31,18,32,36]. 许多内存增强政策注重单一感官历史,要么利用视觉内存保留早期观测[46,13,23,8],要么用扳手内存保留接触时测量的力和扭矩[17,11,19]. 然而,依赖单一内存模式的政策可能会错过另一种模式的关键提示,从而难以完成既需要又需要的任务。

blocks.en: Consider a robot entering a safe’s passcode (Fig. (a)). Visual memory helps the robot track which digits it has attempted and which key to press next. However, the gripper can look nearly identical as it approaches a key and as it lifts away after a press. Visual history alone may therefore leave the robot uncertain whether the key has gone down, causing it to move on before completing the press. Wrench memory supplies the missing cue: the rise and fall of contact force helps distinguish a completed press from an approach. This example motivates a multimodal memory-augmented VLA that integrates visual and wrench memory.
blocks.zh: 考虑一个进入保险箱密码的机器人(图(a))。 视觉记忆帮助机器人追踪它尝试过哪些位数,以及下一个按键. 然而,钳子在接近钥匙时和在报章后抬起时,可以看起来几乎完全一样。 因此,仅凭视觉历史就可能让机器人不确定钥匙是否已经下沉,导致它在完成报章前继续前进. 扳机内存提供缺失的提示:接触力的升降有助于区分完成的媒体与方法. 这个例子激发了一种将视觉记忆和扳手记忆融合在一起的多模式内存增强的VLA.

blocks.en: Recent multimodal VLAs such as DAM-VLA maintain fixed-size buffers for visual and force observations [ 33 ] . These buffers provide direct access to recent observations, but an earlier cue, such as which drawer was initially open (Fig. 4 (a)), can be lost once its frame leaves the window. Test-time training (TTT) extends the memory horizon by summarizing earlier observations in recurrent fast weights [ 30 , 14 , 23 , 34 ] . Compressing the entire visual history into these weights, however, can make details from a particular moment difficult to recover. For wrench memory, the task stage determines how much the policy should rely on contact feedback. Appending wrench tokens to the action expert leaves this weighting implicit [ 19 ] . DAM-VLA and DeCAL make the weighting explicit by gating cross-attention with pooled force features [ 33 ] and a global tactile token [ 7 ] , respectively. Because these gates depend only on contact features, their weights cannot respond directly to changes in the instruction or visual cues to task progress. Moreover, even with wrench memory, a fixed policy can struggle when contact dynamics shift at deployment. For example, raising a whiteboard changes when the eraser meets the surface and how much force it exerts along the same stroke (Fig. (c)).
blocks.zh: 近期的多模式VLA,如DAM-VLA维持固定大小的缓冲器,用于视觉和力观测[33]. 这些缓冲器可以直接访问最近的观测结果,但一个较早的提示,例如抽屉最初是打开的(图4(a)),一旦其框架离开窗口就会丢失。 测试时间训练(TTT)通过在经常性快重[30,14,23,34]中总结早先的观测结果,延长了记忆视野. 然而,将整个视觉历史压缩成这些重量,可以使特定时刻的细节难以恢复. 对于扳手内存,任务阶段决定政策应在多大程度上依赖接触反馈. 给行动专家附加扳手令牌会让这种权重隐含[19]. DAM-VLA和DECAL分别通过标注集合力特征的交叉注意[33]和全球触觉符号[7]来明确权重. 因为这些门只依赖于接触特性,因此其重量不能直接响应指令或视觉提示的改变来任务进度. 此外,即使有了扳手记忆,在部署时接触动态变化时,一项固定政策也可能挣扎。 例如,当擦除器与表面相遇时,升起白板会改变,并沿着同一中风施加多少力(图(c)).

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce M 2 AdaptVLA , a VLA built on WALL-X [ 43 ] that combines multimodal memory with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, we design a TTT bank to retain frame-specific detail while preserving cues beyond the explicit window. Each entry fuses the corresponding frame’s features with a readout from the fast weights at that time (Fig. (b)). For wrench memory, we introduce a context gate that uses the instruction, visual context, and wrench history to determine how strongly the action expert should draw on contact information at each task stage (Fig. (a)). For predictive test-time adaptation, we jointly denoise future actions and wrenches to obtain a wrench forecast for each action sequence. When measurements arrive, we backpropagate the forecast error only through the final denoising step to update low-rank adapters [ 12 ] (Fig. (c)).
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了M 2 AdaptVLA,一种基于WALL-X[43]的VLA,将多式联运内存与预测测试时间适应相结合. 对于视觉内存,我们设计了一个TTT银行,以保留特定帧的细节,同时保留显式窗口以外的提示. 每个条目都以当时快速重量的读出(图(b))。 对于扳手记忆,我们引入了上下文门,使用指令,视觉上下文和扳手历史来确定动作专家在每个任务阶段应如何大力利用联系信息(图(a))。 对于预测试验时间的适应,我们联合将未来的动作和扳手降级,以获得每个动作序列的扳手预报. 当测量结果到达时,我们只能通过最后的去名步骤来背推预报错误,以更新低级适配器[12](图(c)).

blocks.en: To evaluate M 2 AdaptVLA, we design eight real-robot tasks with different demands on visual and wrench memory. Our model achieves a mean task score of 82.71%, an absolute gain of 31.46% over the strongest baseline (51.25%). Ablations show that the TTT bank outperforms the evaluated visual memory baselines on task progress tracking, initial-scene recall, and demonstration following. The context gate also achieves higher mean stage success than either direct wrench injection or the GCA approach. Across the two whiteboard contact shifts, predictive test-time adaptation raises mean wiping success from 85.0% to 97.5%, an absolute gain of 12.5% over the fixed policy. Each update takes 159.5 ms on average on an RTX 5090.
blocks.zh: 为了评价M2 AdaptVLA,我们设计了八项对视觉和扳手记忆有不同要求的真机器人任务. 我们的模型实现了82.71%的平均任务分,绝对比最强基线(51.25%)增加31.46%。 缩写表明,TTT银行在任务进度跟踪、初始场景召回和随后的演示方面,比评估的视觉内存基线要好。 与直接扳手注射或GCA方法相比,上下文门也取得了更高的平均阶段成功. 在两个白板接触班次中,预测的试验时间适应率将平均成功率从85.0%提高到97.5%,比固定政策获得12.5%。 每一次更新平均需要159.5毫秒的RTX 5090.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. • We introduce M 2 AdaptVLA, a multimodal memory-augmented VLA that combines visual memory with context-gated wrench history to jointly predict future actions and wrenches. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness. • We introduce a visual memory bank that fuses each frame’s features with a readout from TTT fast weights, preserving cues from beyond the bank window. • We introduce a predictive test-time adaptation mechanism that updates policy adapters by backpropagating the wrench prediction loss through only the final step of joint action–wrench denoising.

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Memory for Robotic Manipulation
blocks.zh: 2.1 机器人操纵的视觉记忆

blocks.en: Visual memory helps robots track task progress [ 26 , 31 ] and recall scene cues that are no longer visible [ 6 , 5 , 23 , 4 , 29 , 3 ] . A common approach is to maintain a bounded memory bank [ 6 , 26 , 31 , 33 ] . MemoryVLA stores visual features alongside instruction-conditioned cognitive tokens [ 26 ] . MemoAct extends the temporal span of a fixed-size bank by compressing older observations into long-term summaries and merging similar adjacent summaries when space runs out [ 31 ] . Once a frame is evicted or compressed, its details can be recovered only if the remaining entries preserve them. Sparse keyframe methods select which observations to keep [ 28 , 37 , 42 , 27 , 44 ] . MemER selects task-relevant frames from recent observations [ 28 ] , while EventVLA predicts when to store incoming frames [ 37 ] . A transient cue can be lost if the selector misses the frame that contains it. TTT carries history forward through recurrent updates to fast weights [ 30 , 14 , 23 , 1 ] , but fast weights alone provide no explicit record of a particular frame. TTT-RM trains its fast weights to capture history missing from the retrieved context and combines their readout with retrieved bank features during action generation [ 34 ] . M 2 AdaptVLA writes each bank entry as the sum of the current frame’s features and a gated fast-weight readout, preserving frame-specific detail and cues from beyond the window.
blocks.zh: 视觉记忆帮助机器人跟踪任务进度[26,31],并回顾不再可见的场景提示[6,5,23,4,29,3]. 一个共同的做法是维持一个有限度的记忆库[6、26、31、33]。 MemoryVLA将视觉特征与指导性有条件的认知符号一起存储 [26]. MemoAct 扩展了固定大小库的时间跨度,将旧的观测压缩成长期摘要,并在空间耗尽时合并类似的相邻摘要[31]. 一旦一个框架被拆卸或压缩,其细节只有在剩余条目保存的情况下才能恢复. Sparse键框方法选择保留哪些观察[28,37,42,27,44]. Memer从最近的观测结果中选择与任务相关的帧[28],而EventVLA则预测何时存储到来的帧[37]. 如果选择器错过了包含它的框架, 则会丢失一个瞬态提示 。 TTT通过反复更新将历史延续到快重[30,14,23,1],但快重单靠快重并不能明确记录某一帧. TTT-RM 训练其快速重力以捕捉被检索上下文中缺失的历史,并在动作生成过程中将其读取功能与被检索的银行特性结合 [34]. M 2 AdaptVLA 将每个银行条目写成当前帧特性的总称和一个有门的快速重力读取,从窗口外保存帧特定细节和提示.

blocks.en: 2.2 Wrench Memory for Robotic Manipulation
blocks.zh: 2.2 机器人操纵的扳手内存

blocks.en: How much the robot needs to rely on wrench history varies across task stages [ 33 , 10 , 35 ] . TA-VLA encodes torque history as a single decoder token [ 45 ] , and FM-VLA feeds a compressed wrench history to its action expert [ 19 ] . Direct injection leaves the expert to infer when contact history matters. Fusion mechanisms make this choice explicit. DAM-VLA gates cross-attention using pooled force features alone [ 33 ] , so its gate has no direct access to visual cues that distinguish task stages. Other methods use predicted contact to weight force features [ 11 ] , route multimodal features through a mixture of experts [ 39 ] , or infer the contact phase from vision and language to bias attention to wrench tokens [ 10 ] . To weight contact history by task stage, M 2 AdaptVLA combines encoded wrench history with the VLM context. Together they determine how strongly wrench history contributes to joint action–wrench denoising at each joint-attention layer.
blocks.zh: 机器人对扳手历史的依赖程度因任务阶段而异[33,10,35]. TA-VLA将扭矩历史编码为单一解码符[45],FM-VLA将其压缩的扳手历史提供给其动作专家[19]. 直接注射让专家在与历史联系时进行推断. 融合机制明确了这一选择。 DAM-VLA门单独使用集合力特征进行交叉透视[33],因此其门无法直接进入可区分任务阶段的视觉提示. 其他方法使用预测的接触量力特性[11],通过专家混合[39]的路由多式联运特性,或推断接触阶段从视觉和语言到偏重对扳手符的注意[10]. 为按任务阶段衡量接触历史,M2 AdaptVLA将编码的扳手历史与VLM上下文结合. 他们共同决定了扳手历史如何有力地促进联合行动 — — 在每个联合关注层消除扳手。

blocks.en: 2.3 Online Adaptation for Robot Policies
blocks.zh: 2.3 机器人政策在线适应

blocks.en: When contact conditions change at deployment, the same motion can produce a different wrench. Some policies adapt by inferring physical properties or latent dynamics from recent interactions [ 24 , 20 , 15 , 40 ] . Others update parameters through self-supervision, using inverse dynamics [ 9 ] or agreement between overlapping action predictions [ 16 ] . For contact-rich manipulation, a predicted wrench provides a reference that the robot can check against its own measurements [ 22 ] . AdaWorldPolicy first generates actions, then predicts visual and force observations conditioned on those actions and uses the forecast errors to update low-rank adapters [ 41 ] . To respond promptly to changes in contact conditions, M 2 AdaptVLA predicts future actions and wrenches in a single denoising trajectory. Once the corresponding wrench measurements arrive, it limits the cost of each adapter update by backpropagating the wrench prediction loss through only the final denoising step.
blocks.zh: 当部署时接触条件发生变化时,同样的运动可以产生不同的扳手. 一些政策通过从最近的相互作用中推断物理性质或潜在动态来调整[24、20、15、40]。 其他通过自我监督更新参数,使用反向动态[9]或重叠动作预测之间的一致[16]. 对于接触丰富的操纵,一个预测的扳手提供了一个参考,机器人可以对照自己的测量结果来检查[22]. AdaWorld Policy首先生成动作,然后预测以这些动作为条件的视觉和力观测,并利用预测错误更新低级适配器[41]. 为了迅速应对接触条件的变化,M2 AdaptVLA预测未来动作和扳手在一个单一的去诺化轨迹中. 一旦相应的扳手测量结果到达,它通过只通过最后的去诺化步骤背传扳手预测损失来限制每个适配器更新的成本.

Each of the backbone’s six layer groups contains three Gated DeltaNet (GDN) blocks [ 38 ] followed by a full-attention block that connects the VLM to the action expert through joint attention.

A context gate regulates how strongly recent wrench history influences the expert as it jointly predicts an action chunk A t A_{t} and its corresponding wrenches W t + W_{t}^{+} .
At deployment, we adapt the policy by backpropagating the error between predicted and measured wrenches through only the final denoising step.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the performance of M 2 AdaptVLA, we conducted a series of real-robot experiments around the following four questions:
blocks.zh: 为了全面评价M2 AdaptVLA的性能,我们围绕以下四个问题进行了一系列真机器人实验:

blocks.en: (Q1) How does M 2 AdaptVLA compare with state-of-the-art VLA baselines on tasks that rely on visual and wrench memory?
blocks.zh: (问题1) M2 AdaptVLA如何与最先进的VLA基线比较依赖于视觉和扳手记忆的任务?

blocks.en: (Q2) What advantages does the TTT bank offer over existing visual memory methods?
blocks.zh: (问题2) TTT银行比现有的视觉内存方法有什么好处?

blocks.en: (Q3) Does the context gate outperform existing methods for injecting wrench history into the policy?
blocks.zh: (问题3) 上下文门是否超越了现行将扳手历史注入政策的方法?

blocks.en: (Q4) Can a policy with predictive test-time adaptation better handle shifts in contact dynamics at deployment than a fixed policy?
blocks.zh: (问题4) 具有预测性测试时间适应性的政策能否比固定政策更好地处理部署时接触动态的变化?

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use two bimanual platforms (Fig. 3 ). The TeleTwin Desktop from X Square Robot has two six-axis arms, and the Tianji has two seven-axis arms. Both provide images from a fixed front camera and a camera on each wrist, along with proprioception and six-axis wrist wrench measurements.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个双人平台(图3). 来自X Square Robot的TeleTwin桌面有两只六轴臂,而Tianji则有两只七轴臂. 两者都提供来自固定的前置相机和每个手腕上的相机的图像,以及自制和六轴手腕扳手的测量.

blocks.zh: 图3:机器人平台。 TeleTwin桌面(左)和Tianji(右)各有一台前置照相机和两台手腕照相机.

blocks.en: We train M 2 AdaptVLA on eight NVIDIA A800 GPUs. At deployment, we run inference and online adaptation on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090.
blocks.zh: 我们用八台NVIDIA A800 GPU训练M2 AdaptVLA. 在部署时,我们运行推论和在线适应 单NVIDIA RTX 5090。

blocks.en: We designed eight real-robot tasks that rely on visual memory, wrench memory, or both, with 5,953 demonstrations in total (see Table 1 for per-task counts). Figure 4 shows the instruction and a sequence of demonstration frames for each task. We group the tasks by the memory capability they test: visual memory, wrench memory, or both.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了8项依赖于视觉内存,扳手内存或两者的真机器人任务,总共有5,953个演示(每个任务计数见表1). 图4显示每项任务的指令和一系列演示框架。 我们按照它们测试的内存能力来划分任务:视觉内存,扳手内存,或者两者兼有.

blocks.en: In OpenDrawerMem, the robot closes the initially open drawer, picks up an object, and uses visual memory to reopen the same drawer. Four tasks probe wrench memory. In USB-C Insertion and Removal, Insert Plug, and Unplug, changes in wrist force and torque indicate when a connector seats or comes free. In Wipe Board, wrench history helps maintain contact throughout each stroke. The remaining three tasks require both modalities. The robot uses visual memory to track passcode progress in Open Safe, recall the demonstrated order in Button Sequence, and count pump strokes in Double Press. In all three, wrench feedback indicates when each press is complete.
blocks.zh: 在OpenDraverMem中,机器人关闭了最初打开的抽屉,拾取一个物体,并使用视觉内存重新打开同一个抽屉. 四任务探测扳手记忆. 在USB-C插入和去除,插入插件和Unplug中,手腕力和扭矩的变化表示连接器的座位或自由出现. 在擦拭板中,扳手历史有助于保持每次中风的接触。 其余三项任务需要两种方式。 机器人使用视觉内存来跟踪Open Safe的密码进度,回忆在按钮序列中显示的顺序,在Double Press中计数泵中风. 在三部曲中,扳手反馈表示每部媒体何时完成.

blocks.en: (Q1) We use π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 2 ] , a widely used generalist VLA, as our reference policy. We also compare against two VLAs with visual memory, π \pi -Mem (the visual memory variant of MEM [ 32 ] ) and MemoryVLA [ 26 ] , and two force-aware VLAs, ForceVLA [ 39 ] and TA-VLA [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh: (问题1)我们使用 \ 0.5\pi\ 0.5} [2], 一个被广泛使用的通俗主义VLA,作为我们的参考政策. 我们还比较了两个具有视觉内存的VLA,\\pi-Mem(MEM的视觉内存变体[32])和MumionVLA[26],以及两个具有力量意识的VLA,ForceVLA[39]和TA-VLA[45].

blocks.en: (Q2) We compare visual memory designs on the same WALL-X backbone [ 43 ] . Frame Bank stores independently encoded frames in a first-in, first-out buffer, and GDN carries the native Gated DeltaNet state [ 38 ] of Qwen3.5 [ 25 ] across decisions. Figure 5 compares the three designs that use TTT. The TTT only variant fuses the fast-weight readout with current visual features and uses the result at the same decision. The RoboTTT-style implementation [ 14 ] places learned register tokens in the action expert and applies TTT to expert features after attention. Both variants carry history in fast weights. Our TTT bank also stores each fused visual representation in a bounded bank. At the next decision, the policy reads these entries alongside the new camera views. All variants are trained on chronologically ordered decisions within each demonstration (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: (Q2)我们比较同一WALL-X主干线上的视觉内存设计[43]. Frame Bank在先入先出缓冲器中独立存储编码的帧,GDN在决定中携带原生Gated DeltaNet状态[38]的Quen3.5[25]. 图5比较了使用TTT的三种设计. TTT只将快速量级的读取功能与当前视觉特征结合,并在同一决定中使用结果. RoboTT风格的实现[14]在动作专家中放置已学到的注册符,并在注意后将TTT应用于专家特征. 两个变体都以快速重量承载历史. 我们的TTT银行还把每个装有引信的视觉显示器储存在一个有界的银行. 在下一个决定中,政策将这些条目与新的镜头视图一起阅读。 所有变体在每次演示中都接受按时间顺序决定的培训(附录A )。

blocks.en: (Q3) To evaluate the context gate, we keep the TTT bank fixed and vary only how wrench history enters the policy. Two variants append wrench tokens directly to the VLM input or to the action expert, the latter following TA-VLA [ 45 ] . A third uses gated cross-attention (GCA) with a gate computed from pooled wrench features, following DAM-VLA [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh: (Q3)为了评价上下文门,我们保持TTT银行的固定,并且只改变扳手历史进入政策的方式. 两个变体将扳手符直接附加到VLM输入或动作专家身上,后者遵循TA-VLA [45]. 第三个是使用门式交叉式(GCA),根据DAM-VLA[33]之后的集合扳手特性计算出一个门。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验结果

blocks.en: Effective manipulation across these tasks calls for both visual and wrench memory. A single memory modality can capture the evidence needed for one task yet miss a decisive cue in another. As shown in Table 1 , the relative strengths of the baselines reverse across two tasks. On Button Sequence, the robot must recall the demonstrated order. Both visual memory baselines reach 55% success, while both force-aware baselines score 0%. On USB-C Insertion and Removal, wrist feedback indicates when a connector seats or comes free. Here the force-aware baselines reach 40–50%, compared with 15–30% for the visual memory baselines. M 2 AdaptVLA performs best on both tasks, achieving 80% and 65%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 有效操纵这些任务既需要视觉记忆,也需要扳手记忆. 单一的内存模式可以捕捉一项任务所需的证据,但却错过另一项任务的决定性提示。 如表1所示,基线的相对优势在两项任务中颠倒。 在按钮序列上,机器人必须记得显示的顺序. 两种视觉内存基线都达到了55%的成功率,同时两种力量感知基线的得分都达到0%. 在USB-C插入和移除上,手腕反馈显示连接器的座位或自由出现. 在此,视力意识基线达到40-50%,而视觉记忆基线为15-30%。 M2 AdaptVLA在这两项任务上表现最好,分别达到80%和65%.

blocks.en: Open Safe requires both histories: visual memory tracks the next key, while wrench history indicates whether a press is complete. M 2 AdaptVLA achieves 66.7% success, compared with 26.7% for MemoryVLA, the strongest baseline on this task. Across eight tasks, our policy ranks first on seven and ties for first on Unplug, achieving 82.71% mean success, an absolute gain of 31.46% over π \pi -Mem (51.25%).
blocks.zh: Open Safe需要两种历史:视觉内存跟踪下一个密钥,而扳手历史则表明一个新闻机是否完整. M2 AdaptVLA获得了66.7%的成功率,而记忆VLA则获得了26.7%的成功率,而记忆VLA是这项任务的最强基线. 在8项任务中,我们的政策在7项中位居第一,在Unplug中位居第一,取得了82.71%的成功,比\\\\\\Mem(51.25%)获得31.46%的绝对收益。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: The TTT bank improves progress tracking during passcode entry. On Open Safe, it completes 69.7% of individual keypresses, compared with 35.0% for GDN, 34.0% for Frame Bank, and 30.0% for TTT only (Table 2 ). For example, in failed Frame Bank trials, the robot often moved to the next key before pressing the current one. Because the bank stores each frame independently, the policy must infer progress from views that look nearly identical just before a press and just after release.
blocks.zh: TTT银行在密码输入时改进进度跟踪. 在Open Safe上,它完成了69.7%的单个按键,而GDN为35.0%,Frame Bank为34.0%,仅TTT为30.0%(表2)。 例如,在失败的Frama Bank试验中,机器人经常在按下当前键前移动到下一个键. 因为银行独立储存每个框架,所以政策必须从新闻发布前和发布后看来几乎相同的观点推断进步。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Where TTT memory enters the policy. (a) The fast-weight readout enters the current visual input. (b) Layer-local fast weights feed a gated residual back into the action expert before its feed-forward block. (c) A bank entry written at decision t t first becomes available at t + 1 t+1 , when it can be read alongside fresh visual features.
blocks.zh: 图5 : TTT内存输入策略的地方. (a) 快速读取输入当前视觉输入。 (b) 地层-局部快速重量在运料前向行动专家输入有门的残留物。 (c) 以t t号决定书写的银行条目首先以t + 1 t+1的形式提供,同时可读取新的视觉特征。

blocks.en: By comparison, TTT only and RoboTTT-style advanced prematurely less often, but their presses frequently missed the small target key. Both variants update their fast weights after a fixed number of action steps (Fig. (b)). This implicit progress cue may explain why they were less likely than Frame Bank to move on before attempting a press. However, both variants compress visual history into fast weights and integrate the readout with features from the current frame, either in the visual input or in the action expert. Without a separate bank of historical features, the policy may have difficulty recovering the fine spatial cues needed to align the gripper with a small key. M 2 AdaptVLA retains the progress cue while supplying the current views separately from the historical bank, allowing the policy to align the gripper directly from those views.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,只有TTT和RoboTT风格的提前推进的频率较低,但他们的按压经常错过小目标键. 两个变体在固定的动作步骤后更新其快速重量(图(b)). 这一隐含的进展提示可以解释为什么它们比Frame Bank在尝试新闻前更不可能继续前进。 然而,两种变体都将视觉历史压缩成快速的重量,并结合了从当前帧中的特性,无论是视觉输入还是动作专家中. 由于没有单独的历史特征库,该政策可能难以恢复将夹子与小钥匙连接起来所需的细微空间提示。 M2 AdaptVLA保留了进度提示,同时将当前的观点与历史库分开提供,使政策能够直接与这些观点保持一致。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Visual memory for drawer recall and button-sequence following. Whole-task success (%) over 20 trials per condition.
blocks.zh: 表3:抽屉召回的视觉内存和按键顺序如下。 全任务成功率(%),每个条件20次以上。

blocks.en: Beyond tracking an ongoing action, the TTT bank also helps the robot recall the initial scene. On OpenDrawerMem, the robot must reopen the drawer that was initially open. As shown in Table 3 , the TTT bank achieves 90% whole-task success, compared with 75% for TTT only, 70% for Frame Bank, and 55% for RoboTTT-style. The bank can preserve the initial drawer configuration because each entry combines the visual features of a particular frame with a readout of the history up to that point (Eq. 3 ). Later entries can thus retain cues about which drawer was open even after the initial view leaves the bank.
blocks.zh: 除了跟踪一个正在进行的动作,TTT银行还帮助机器人回忆起最初的场景. 在OpenDraverMem上,机器人必须重新打开最初打开的抽屉. 如表3所示,TTT银行实现了90%的全任务成功率,而TTT只实现了75%,Frame银行实现了70%,RoboTT型实现了55%. 银行可以保留最初的抽屉配置,因为每个条目将特定帧的视觉特征与直到那个点的历史读出(Eq. 3 . 因此,即使初始视图离开银行,以后的条目仍可保留抽屉打开的提示。

blocks.en: The advantage extends from recalling an initial scene to following a demonstrated sequence. On Button Sequence, the robot must remember the order in which the demonstrator presented the button cues. With the TTT bank, it reproduces that order in 80% of trials, compared with 60% for RoboTTT-style, the strongest alternative on this task.
blocks.zh: 其优势从回顾最初的场景到遵循经证明的顺序。 在按钮序列上,机器人必须记住演示人呈现按钮提示的顺序. 与TTT银行一样,它复制了80%的试验顺序,而RoboTTT型的试验比例为60%,是这项工作中最强的替代品。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , with the same TTT bank, the context gate achieves 79.6% mean stage success on Open Safe, compared with 69.4% for direct injection into the action expert, 31.5% for direct injection into the VLM, and 48.5% for GCA. Direct injection makes wrench tokens available at every stage but leaves their relevance to be inferred through attention. Explicitly weighting their contribution improves success over direct expert input from 51.7% to 75.0% for key insertion and from 38.3% to 70.0% for the final keypad press.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,由于TTT银行相同,上下文门在Open Safety上取得了79.6%的平均舞台成功率,而直接注射给动作专家的比例为69.4%,直接注射给VLM的比例为31.5%,GCA的比例为48.5%。 直接注射使每个阶段都有扳手标志,但通过注意可以推断其相关性。 明确衡量其贡献,比直接专家投入(钥匙插入量从51.7%提高到75.0%,最后键盘印刷量从38.3%提高到70.0%)的成功率要好。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Context gate and GCA gate values across stages of the same Open Safe episode.
blocks.zh: 图6:背景门和GCA门值横跨同一个开放安全插曲的各阶段.

blocks.en: Figure 6 compares the two gates on the same Open Safe episode. The context gate gives wrench history greater weight as the robot inserts the key, when resistance can reveal misalignment, and less weight as it swings the unlocked door open. This variation suggests that the policy learns to use contact feedback selectively as the task progresses. However, because GCA computes its gate from pooled wrench features alone, it cannot adjust the weight directly in response to visual cues about task progress. Its gate weight remained nearly constant across stages in this episode.
blocks.zh: 图6比较了同一个"开放安全"(Open Safe)插曲上的两扇门. 上下文门在机器人插入密钥时给予扳手历史更大的重量,当阻力可以显示错配时,当它摆动解锁门打开时,重量会减少. 这一变化表明,随着任务的进展,政策学会有选择地使用联系反馈。 然而,由于GCA仅从集合扳手特性计算出它的门,它无法直接根据任务进度的视觉提示来调整重量. 它的门重量在本集的各个阶段几乎保持不变.

blocks.en: In addition, using future wrench prediction as auxiliary supervision raises keypad press success from 71.0% to 75.7% and mean stage success from 79.6% to 83.3%. These gains show that training the policy to predict actions and wrenches jointly can improve task performance.
blocks.zh: 此外,利用未来扳手预测作为辅助监督,键盘压板的成功率从71.0%提高到75.7%,平均阶段成功率从79.6%提高到83.3%。 这些成果表明,对政策进行培训,以便共同预测行动与困难,可以改善任务执行情况。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Whiteboard contact conditions. The board is (a) flat at its original height, (b) raised, or (c) flipped with its rear edge raised.
blocks.zh: 图7:白板接触条件. 该板为(a) 原高度平坦,(b) 抬高,或(c) 后缘抬高而翻转。

blocks.en: Raising or flipping the contact surface changes the load on the eraser during wiping. Both policies observe wrist wrenches, but the adaptive policy also uses the difference between predicted and measured wrenches to update its adapters. As shown in Table 4 , this raises whole-task success from 90% to 100% on the raised board and from 80% to 95% on the flipped board with its rear edge raised.
blocks.zh: 提升或翻转接触表面会改变擦拭器上的负载. 这两种政策都观察腕扳,但适应性政策也利用预测和测量扳机的区别来更新其适配器. 如表4所示,在提升板上,整个任务的成功率从90%提高到100%,在提升后缘的翻转板上从80%提高到95%。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Predictive test-time adaptation on Wipe Board. Success rates are based on 20 trials per policy and condition. Parentheses give the relative change ( Δ \Delta ) from the fixed policy. LoRA variants were timed sequentially on one RTX 5090.
blocks.zh: 表4:对擦拭板的预测试验时间调整。 成功率根据每项政策和条件进行20次试验。 括号中给出了固定策略的相对变化(\\\Delta ) 。 LORA变体依次在1个RTX 5090上定时.

blocks.en: Adapting more layers did not improve robustness. LoRA in the first four layers of both the VLM and action expert achieved 97.5% mean success, compared with 87.5% for all 24 layers and 85.0% for the fixed policy. The two adaptive variants tied on the flipped board, but only the four-layer variant improved on the fixed policy when the entire board was raised. Four-layer updates take 159.5 ms on an RTX 5090, compared with 267.7 ms for all layers.
blocks.zh: 调整更多层次并不能提高稳健性。 LORA在VLM和动作专家的前四层都取得了97.5%的成功,而所有24层都取得了87.5%的成功,固定政策取得了85.0%的成功。 两个适应性变体捆绑在翻板上,但只有四层变体在整板抬高时改善了固定政策. 四层更新在RTX 5090上需要159.5 ms,而所有层的更新则需要267.7 ms.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced M 2 AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action policy that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation.
In real-robot experiments, its TTT bank outperformed visual memory baselines in tracking task progress, recalling the initial scene, and following demonstrated sequences.
The context gate adjusted the influence of wrench history across task stages.
Predictive test-time adaptation improved robustness to changes in contact conditions with low update latency.
Across eight real-robot tasks, M 2 AdaptVLA achieved 82.71% mean success, an absolute gain of 31.46% over the strongest baseline.
A limitation of our approach is that maintaining both visual and wrench memories increases overall inference latency.
In future work, we will explore a two-timescale architecture in which a slow module updates multimodal memory and a fast controller uses the latest memory and current observations to select actions in real time.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了M 2 AdaptVLA,这是一种视觉语言动作政策,将视觉记忆和扳手记忆与预测测试时间适应相结合.
在真机器人实验中,它的TTT库在跟踪任务进度,回顾初始场景,以及遵循所显示的序列时,表现超过了视觉内存基线.
上下文门调整了扳手历史跨任务阶段的影响.
预测性测试时间适应性提高了适应接触条件变化的稳健性,且更新延迟度低.
在8项实际机器人任务中,M2 AdaptVLA取得了82.71%的成功,绝对收益超过最强基线31.46%。
我们方法的一个局限性是,既保持视觉记忆,又保持扳手记忆,从而增加总的推论延迟性。
在未来的工作中,我们将探索一种双倍规模的架构,其中一个慢模块更新多式联运内存,一个快控制器使用最新的内存和当前观察来实时选择动作.

blocks.en: For the Open Safe ablations, we train all five visual memory variants on chronologically ordered decisions. After filtering stationary frames, we sample a contiguous window of 1,000 frames per demonstration each epoch, using the full filtered sequence for shorter demonstrations. We select the first frame and then every 16th frame, yielding at most 63 decisions per window. Frame Bank retains independently encoded frames. The TTT bank, TTT only, GDN, and RoboTTT-style variants carry their respective memory states across decisions.

blocks.en: Each GPU processes up to 12 successive decisions from one window per segment, giving at most 96 decision positions across eight GPUs. A full 63-decision window therefore spans six segments. Only valid supervised positions contribute to the loss. We initialize the fast weights and FIFO bank at the start of each sampled window and carry their values across segments with gradients detached. We replay the preceding segment’s final bank write from its detached input so that the next segment can supervise that write. Gradients accumulate across segments; the outer optimizer takes one step when the windows finish. Thus, 12 bounds the gradient horizon without limiting the history available for prediction.

blocks.zh: 前向和后向要求可以分别检查. 持慢的权重固定后,将重播状态与原始的后写状态进行比较:条目时间戳和FIFO顺序应准确商定,特征值和快速状态递增应达到数字精度. 对于后置检查,使用第一个读取重播条目的有监督的预测. 它的丢失有一条通往编剧和所学到的初始化的路径,但没有一条通往产生脱落的前写状态的计算路径. 仅匹配 FIFO 内容仅测试前进要求 。

blocks.en: The wrench encoder projects each 12-coordinate row to 256 channels. Three residual temporal convolutions with kernel width three and dilations 1 , 2 , 4 1,2,4 use left padding only. The output has ten rows; there is no pooling over time. An encoded row can therefore summarize preceding contact changes without incorporating a later measurement. The coordinate mask is applied before the projection. A row with at least one valid wrist remains available; a wholly missing row is zeroed after each residual block and excluded from attention.
blocks.zh: 扳手编码器将每条12个坐标线投射到256个信道. 内核宽度3的3个剩余时间演化和1号,2号,4号,1号,2号,4号,4号仅使用左垫. 产出有十行;随着时间的推移,没有集合。 因此,编码的行可以总结先前的接触变化,而不包含以后的测量. 坐标罩在投影前应用. 至少有一副有效手腕的一行仍然可用;每块残块后,一行完全缺失,并排除注意。

blocks.en: At each full-attention layer, the incoming denoising features supply the queries and the ten encoded rows supply the keys and values of an eight-head wrench cross-attention. The context gate takes the VLM gate-token readout, all ten ordered wrench features, and their coordinate-validity flags as inputs. It produces one scalar for that layer and observation, shared across the denoising tokens. Its linear projection is initialized to zero, so the wrench residual starts at zero; after training, its contribution can vary with both task context and contact history. When the entire history is missing, the residual is zero irrespective of the gate. This is why an absent measurement and a measured zero wrench are treated differently.
blocks.zh: 在每一个全注层,进场的去诺特征提供查询,10个编码的行提供八头扳手交叉注意的键和值. 上下文门采用 VLM 门脚本读取,全部十个订购的扳手特性,以及它们的坐标-有效性旗作为输入. 它为这层层和观测产生一个标尺, 并共享在装饰符号上。 它的线性预测初始化为零,因此扳手残留开始为零;经过训练后,它的贡献可以随任务背景和接触历史而变化. 当整个历史缺失时,不管大门在哪里,剩余部分都是零. 这就是为什么对缺失的测量和测量到的零扳手的处理不同。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , adapting layers 1–4 raises success from 75% to 85%, a relative improvement of 13.3%, whereas adapting all 24 layers achieves 70%. Consistent with the whiteboard results, adapting more layers does not necessarily improve robustness to changed contact conditions. Figure 11 illustrates the benefit of the four-layer configuration: the fixed policy repeatedly attempts insertion without seating the plug, whereas the adaptive policy completes insertion after an initially unsuccessful attempt. These results extend the evidence for predictive adaptation to contact changes in plug insertion.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,第1至第4层的改造将成功率从75%提高到85%,相对提高13.3%,而所有24层的改造则达到70%。 与白板结果一致,调整更多层不一定能改善强性以适应改变的接触条件. 图11显示了四层配置的好处:固定政策多次尝试插入而不给插座设座位,而适应政策则在最初尝试失败后完成插入. 这些结果扩展了预测性适应的证据,以适应插件插入中的接触变化.
